court: Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit

issues.label: Section 1252(f)(1) bar on class relief
issues.why: The court must determine whether the jurisdiction-stripping provision precludes class-wide declaratory relief as well as injunctive relief.

issues.label: Injunction versus declaratory relief distinction
issues.why: Whether Aleman Gonzalez's holding on injunctions extends to bar declaratory judgments affecting section 1226(a)'s operation.

issues.label: Article III standing of representative
issues.why: Whether the released plaintiff retains a personal stake to pursue class-wide relief.

issues.label: Mootness of individual claims
issues.why: Plaintiff's release on bond may moot his individual claim absent an exception.

issues.label: Inherently-transitory exception applicability
issues.why: Whether the transitory-claims doctrine preserves the class action despite the representative's release.

issues.label: Propriety of class decertification
issues.why: Whether Rule 23(b)(2) certification remains appropriate when injunctive relief is unavailable.

issues.label: Rule 23(b)(2) cohesiveness requirement
issues.why: Whether declaratory relief alone satisfies the indivisible-remedy predicate for a (b)(2) class.

issues.label: Discretion to grant declaratory judgment
issues.why: The Declaratory Judgment Act's discretionary nature lets the court decline relief even if authorized.

issues.label: Due process burden of proof allocation
issues.why: Whether the Fifth Amendment requires the government, not the noncitizen, to justify detention.

issues.label: Clear-and-convincing evidentiary standard
issues.why: Whether due process mandates that heightened standard rather than preponderance in bond hearings.

issues.label: Ability-to-pay consideration requirement
issues.why: Whether due process requires IJs to consider financial ability when setting bond.

issues.label: Alternatives-to-detention consideration requirement
issues.why: Whether IJs must consider non-bond conditions of release under due process.

issues.label: Deference to BIA precedent
issues.why: Whether Matter of Guerra and Barreiros warrant deference against the constitutional challenge.

issues.label: Mathews v. Eldridge balancing
issues.why: The court must weigh private interests, error risk, and government interests for procedural due process.

issues.label: Effect of stipulation vacating injunction
issues.why: Whether the parties' stipulation and prior vacatur affect available remedies on remand.

issues.label: Redressability of declaratory relief
issues.why: Whether a declaration would meaningfully redress plaintiff's or class members' injuries.

issues.label: Practical effect equivalent to injunction
issues.why: Whether declaratory relief would functionally 'enjoin or restrain' operation of the statute under 1252(f)(1).

issues.label: Scope of remand mandate
issues.why: Whether appellate proceedings constrained the district court's authority on remand.

issues.label: Class definition geographic limitation
issues.why: Whether limiting the class to one facility affects certification and relief propriety.

issues.label: Prospective versus retrospective relief
issues.why: Whether relief concerns future hearings only, affecting mootness and jurisdiction analysis.
